## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible change and link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any remaining manual verification. Include sanitized screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility and local operation

- Does this change project storage, import/export compatibility, permissions, dependencies, or network behavior?
- Confirm that core workflows remain local and personal recordings/credentials are excluded.

Keep unrelated formatting and refactors separate. Submit only code/assets you are entitled to contribute under Apache-2.0.
